description.value: Morrisey's Public House is a casual, locals'-favourite pub inside Sun Peaks Grand Hotel in the mountain village of Sun Peaks, BC, known for hearty comfort food — slow-smoked brisket, Gunpowder Fried Chicken Sandwiches, and rotating craft drafts — alongside live music and friendly après-adventure atmosphere. A heated, pet-friendly patio overlooks the village, making it a natural stop after a day on the trails or slopes. The pub is one of two dining venues at Sun Peaks Grand and draws both hotel guests and resort regulars.
